job.job_description:
Develop modern frontend applications using frameworks such as React/Next.js and follow scalable and secure frontend development practices.
Build backend services, microservices, and APIs using Python/FastAPI or similar technologies.
Design and integrate Generative AI/LLM solutions, including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, and multi-LLM applications.
Develop Agentic AI solutions using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar technologies.
Design AI-powered document processing and OCR solutions, including document extraction and intelligent information processing.
Apply practical knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Computer Vision to real-world AI applications.
Design scalable system architectures covering application components, APIs, databases, AI services, caching, load balancing, and integrations.
Implement enterprise security and authentication practices such as SSO, OAuth/OIDC, JWT, and role-based access control.
Work with databases and data technologies such as PostgreSQL, Redis, Vector Databases, and other relevant data stores.
Develop and integrate REST APIs, internal APIs, streaming APIs, WebSockets, and third-party/enterprise services.
Work with Git, CI/CD, Docker, cloud platforms, and deployment practices to deliver production-ready applications.
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI models, frameworks, and AI developer tools to improve application capabilities and developer productivity.

Required Skills

Frontend: React / Next.js / TypeScript / JavaScript
Backend: Python / FastAPI / REST APIs / Microservices
GenAI: LLMs / RAG / Embeddings / Vector Search / Prompt Engineering
Agentic AI: LangGraph / LangChain / LlamaIndex or equivalent
AI/ML: Machine Learning / Deep Learning / NLP / Computer Vision
Document AI: OCR / Document Processing / Information Extraction
Databases: PostgreSQL / Redis / Vector Databases
Architecture: System Design / Application Architecture / Microservices
Security: SSO / OAuth / JWT / RBAC
Integration: APIs / WebSockets / SSE / Third-party integrations
DevOps: Git / Docker / CI/CD / Cloud
AI Tools: AI-assisted development tools and LLM-based developer workflo
